name: AI Recommender
description: AI-powered smart playlists and recommendations for Jellyfin (For You, Because You Watched, Hidden Gems, Discover, Wild Card, per-user Letterboxd watchlist). Learns from what you watch.
overview: Builds real similarity-ranked playlists that learn from your watch history. Config-page transparency panel shows exactly why each movie is surfaced or excluded. Self-hosted plugin repository (served via GitHub Pages).

versions.changelog: - **Discover and Wild Card playlists now always appear.** Both generators silently produced nothing when their strict filters yielded zero candidates (e.g. least-familiar subcategories already exhausted by other playlists), and `CreateOrUpdateJellyfinPlaylistAsync` skips empty playlists — so they vanished. Added fallbacks: Discover falls back to top-acclaim unwatched films; Wild Card falls back to any high-acclaim unwatched film. Fixes "admin missing some playlists."
User exclusions now take effect immediately on save (purge disabled users' playlists). Debug panel capped at 50 entries each for penalties/boosts so it doesn't fail on large libraries.
Fixed no-such-table:Affinities crash on existing databases.
Warning-clean build (0 warnings). XML doc generation off; nullable warnings fixed. No behavior change.
